verdicts.evidence: Without the isRealAdr filter, adrCount counts the scaffolded template ADR-0000-template.md and any empty file — the empty-file defence is skipped for this count (measured: scaffold adr 0->1, the template counts as a decision). KILLED BY THE SMOKE LEG, VERIFIED by replaying it: exit 1, the same assertion smoke.js:457 fails — on the mission carrying ADR-0000-template.md + ADR-0021-timeout-10000-ms.md the mutant prints 'ADRs 2' where /ADRs\s+1\b/ is required. The 6 other legs pass (the count is advisory; the '≥1 ADR' gate goes through artifactState('adr'), which keeps its own filter, not mutated here).
